# Security policy

## Report privately

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Use [GitHub's private vulnerability report](https://github.com/IQMO/MO-Downloads/security/advisories/new)
for the official MO distribution. Sign in to GitHub to submit it privately.
If that route is unavailable, do not substitute a public issue or upload
sensitive evidence there.

Include the affected installed product version or Android Store version, the
security impact, the smallest safe reproduction, and sanitized
supporting evidence. Do not include live credentials, provider keys, pairing
grants, private Hub URLs, personal conversations, a complete MO state home, or
unrelated logs. Revoke or rotate any credential that may already have been exposed.

## Scope

Reports may cover an available MO product release or the official Google Play
build. A third-party provider,
model, operating system, network, or self-hosted deployment is in scope only when
an MO defect creates or amplifies the security issue.

This owner-maintained project does not promise a bounty, disclosure deadline, or
response-time SLA. Please keep the report private until the maintainer has
assessed it and coordinated any necessary release.
